environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) running as a systemd service under the 'webapp' user. The instance has IAM role with S3 read access. ImageMagick 7.1 and exiftool 12.x installed system-wide. No additional sandboxing or input filtering applied. The service is exposed via an NLB (Network Load Balancer) on port 8080 with no additional inspection layer. Security groups allow inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0.
